_description: Alarm specification per state — single source of truth for Web PoC, Python CLI, and future Jetson Orin/ROS2 nodes. `alarms` covers Mode A (in-car infant monitoring). `stroller` covers Mode B (outward hazard detection).

_levels.2: warning — head bent sustained / stroller WARN
_levels.3: critical — both sustained (positional asphyxia risk) / stroller DANGER
